verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham gur naanak dheau|

en.bdb: Guru Nanak is perfect and transcendental Brahm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗ ਤੇ ਸਚ ਸਬਦ ਸਮੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: gur a(n)gadh gur a(n)g te sach sabadh sameau|

en.bdb: Guru Angad attained merger in Word by being in the company of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਗਦਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: amaraa padh gur a(n)gadhahu at alakh abheau|

en.bdb: After Guru Angad, the imperceptible and without duality, Guru Amas Das, the bestower of immortality has flourished.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਛੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: gur amarahu gur raam naam gat achhal achheau|

en.bdb: After Guru Amar Das, the forbearing and storehouse of infinite virtues, Guru Ram Das made manifest his existence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਸਕ ਅਰਜਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਬਿਚਲ ਅਰਖੇਉ।
verses.translit_en: raam rasak arajan guroo abichal arakheau|

en.bdb: From Guru Ram Das, Guru Arjan Dev, who absorbed one in Ram-Nam, beyond all blemishes and immovable one, was born.
Then came Guru Hargobind who is the cause of all the causes i.e. who is Gobind, the Lord himself.
